services.name: ANY.RUN
services.unlocks: /anyrun + /binary: ANY.RUN TI Lookup over prior detonations (contacted domains/IPs/URLs, family label) — the only way to recover a PACKED sample's runtime endpoints — plus your own task history/reports. NOTE: a sandbox key is a SEPARATE licence from TI Lookup; settle it with `bp_anyrun.py keycheck --probe` (the plain license check false-greens a sandbox key). Detonating a file/URL (`anyrun_submit`) is possible with this key but stays behind a per-submission analyst confirmation, private-by-default privacy, a fail-closed plan check (/user private quota — zero is denied outright — else a prior private task on record, else explicit analyst attestation), and a post-submit privacy read-back that withdraws a task that still landed public

services.name: Passive DNS / Passive SSL (CIRCL COF)
services.unlocks: /webpivot: historical A/AAAA (the IPs a host used before its current CDN front) + co-hosted domains, and the cert->IP passive-SSL direction that recovers an origin from behind a CDN (one CIRCL account covers both). Needs PDNS_USERNAME + PDNS_PASSWORD (+ optional PDNS_URL for a COF-compatible instance)

services.name: IPinfo

services.name: FlareSolverr

services.name: Google Gemini (vision/A-V)
services.unlocks: media-vision-analysis: multix Gemini image OCR + sign/landmark/logo/face read, structured selector extraction, and A/V transcription (npx @mrgoonie/multix). Keyless collection still works; vision/transcription need this key

services.name: Netlas
services.unlocks: /webpivot: independent DNS + scan + WHOIS + cert index — `domains a:<origin-ip>` reverses a non-CDN origin (shared mail/web host) to every apex with dates (measured: 32 apexes, 15 estate + same-MO siblings under other personas); ns:/txt:spf provider reverses as counts; per-domain registrar/created cross-check. Paid plans unlimited requests; Cloudflare-fronted (browser UA required)
